reader_summary.overview: Porter Collins and Vincent Daniel are the founders of Seawolf Capital, their family office managed as an old school hedge fund. Previously. Regulations prevent us from disclosing investment returns almost all the time on the show. In the three full years since they started managing their own capital, the pair is up an extraordinary 9x, coming off a 169% return in 2022.
